subject: Rio Health — engagement playbook (initial MAP draft and timeline options)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@riohealth.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@riohealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Rio Health discovery + engagement playbook (initial draft)

Hi Rita / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from the discovery and an initial engagement playbook (attached) so we can align on milestones, owners, and a realistic close window. High-level notes below: 

- Key pains you emphasized: unpredictable inference latency under batch workloads, cost spikes during month-end reporting, and the need for isolated data controls for patient data.
- Primary internal stakeholders we heard: Rita (Clinical Ops), Tom (IT / Infra), and Procurement (TBD).
- Proposed target close (initial): 2027-01-15 — this assumes procurement and security review start within 2 weeks.

Initial MAP (attached: RH_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx) — highlights:
- Milestone 1: Pilot environment + sample workload (owner: Rio IT) — target: 3 weeks from kickoff
- Milestone 2: Performance tuning & quantization validation (owner: Redwood Eng) — target: 4 weeks after pilot
- Milestone 3: Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence exchange (owner: Rio Security / Procurement) — owner: Rio
- Milestone 4: PO + go-live on dedicated capacity (owner: Rio Procurement / Redwood Sales) — target: target close date

Dependencies we called out: procurement timeline, SOC2 evidence turnaround, and availability of a representative production sample for tuning.

Ask: Can you confirm the stakeholder list (names & emails) and whether a target close around mid-Jan (2027-01-15) is realistic for you? If procurement will need more runway, we can present two timeline options.

Attachments: RH_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (map draft), capacity_estimates.pdf (rough spend model)

Next steps: if you confirm stakeholders I’ll circulate a short version of the MAP that lists owners and hard dates so we can lock the first steering meeting.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@riohealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@riohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Rio Health discovery + engagement playbook (initial draft)

Marcus — thanks for the summary and draft. Good capture of the discussion. A few notes from our side: 

- Stakeholders:
  - Rita Gomez (Clinical Ops) — rita.gomez@riohealth.com (me)
  - Tom Weaver (Infrastructure) — tom.weaver@riohealth.com
  - Maya Singh (Procurement lead) — maya.singh@riohealth.com (will loop her in shortly)
  - Andrew Holt (Security) — andrew.holt@riohealth.com (for SOC2 items)

- Procurement timing: likely needs 6 weeks once legal has redlines; we have a standing procurement review on Wednesdays. I suspect our PO will slip past mid-Jan unless we accelerate approvals.
- Suggested target close: 2027-02-01 as a more realistic baseline given procurement and a required security review.

I’ve attached a brief procurement intake matrix (procurement_matrix.pdf) that shows our typical timelines and required artifacts.

If you can send two timeline options (aggressive + conservative) with clear owner accountability, that will help me push this internally. Also include a short one-pager for procurement that calls out data residency and audit log capabilities — that’s the first thing my legal/procurement team asks for.

Thanks,
Rita
VP Clinical Operations, Rio Health
rita.gomez@riohealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@riohealth.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@riohealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Rio Health discovery + engagement playbook (initial draft)

Thanks Rita — very helpful context and appreciated the procurement matrix. Based on your notes I updated the playbook and created two timeline options in RH_MAP_DRAFT_v2.xlsx (attached). Short summary below: 

Option A — Accelerated (close target: 2027-01-27)
- Assumptions: procurement and legal prioritize review (PO issued within 3 weeks), security provides SOC2 excerpts in parallel, Rio provides representative workload immediately.
- Key owners:
  - Pilot env provisioning: Tom Weaver (Rio) — due by 2026-11-30
  - Performance tuning & validation: Redwood Eng (owner: Jordan Blake) — due by 2026-12-21
  - Security evidence exchange: Andrew Holt (Rio) + Laura Bennett (Redwood) — initiate by 2026-11-17
  - PO / Commercial sign-off: Maya Singh (Rio) / Marcus Lin (Redwood) — target PO by 2026-12-07

Option B — Conservative (close target: 2027-02-14)
- Assumptions: procurement follows typical 6-week cadence, security review is sequential, some tuning work deferred until after PO.
- Key owners and shifted dates included in the attached.

Proposed immediate asks:
1) Confirm stakeholder roster (including procurement + security contacts) — I copied the names you listed; please reply-all to confirm or update.
2) Which option should we present to your procurement/legal team? We can prepare a 1-page security + audit log summary for them (Laura can help).
3) If Option A is acceptable, can your procurement commit to initiating legal review this week?

I’ll update the MAP and push the v2 file to the shared Drive link in the thread once you confirm.

Thanks —
Marcus

Hi all — jumping in with a short onboarding / procurement-ready packet. Marcus — I prepared the 1-pager Rita requested that summarizes data residency, audit log capabilities, and our SOC2 excerpts. Attaching onboarding-checklist.docx and the procurement one-pager to this thread.

Quick notes:
- Onboarding activities we’ll run in parallel (if Option A is selected): account provisioning, baseline performance run, and KV cache validation. Estimated effort: 2 full engineer-days for warm-up + 1 day for validation.
- Commercial: Marcus, if Rio is comfortable moving faster, we can draft a short SOW addendum that limits the initial committed capacity and adds a 30-day evaluation window. That often helps procurement sign off faster.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.docx, procurement-onepage.pdf

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call this week to walk procurement/legal through the one-pager.

Best,
Laura Bennett
